title: Rebuild recusado após drift persistente, com reader corrente ainda em HOLD

execution.method: Source-grounded case mining; not product execution

limits: Não é aceite global nem fechamento do AC-07.
G3-01, G3-02 e G3-03 são herdados sem novo julgamento; AC-03 não é reaberto; old-producer permanece INDETERMINATE.
Nenhum cenário permite servir bytes/sidecar untrusted. Reviews de fixture são mecânicos e explicitamente sintéticos.
minedFinding: Executor line 263 returns evaluator HOLD and never publishes; the published reader independently checks current source bindings. Their composition supports an expected refusal but is not a new observed execution. RB-13 demonstrates a lower-level evaluator HOLD with an in-memory fixture, and RB-20 checks only an independent direct-CAS read, not this failed-rebuild current publication sequence.

entryPoints.symbol: Failure: rebuildOwnershipUpdate(request) -> request.recipes.get(key).run -> request.evaluate; no activation on HOLD.
Current observation: a separately opened composeRuntime(repoPath).ownership.read/query and ownership.index, including after reopening the disk store.

preconditions.fixture: Real disk/Git ownershipFixture extended with fixed recipe declarations. Synthetic fixture reviews remain explicitly synthetic.
preconditions.graph: base -> operations, mais scope independent. base vincula file:src/util.ts e sua receita; operations vincula sua receita e o resultado de base; independent vincula file:src/independent.ts criado antes do baseline e sua própria receita.
preconditions.baseline: Governedly activate M_before and record ready current read and identity tuple. Capture projection family names/bytes and independent scope's manifest/result.
preconditions.drift: Write changed src/util.ts bytes once and keep them changed. Observe inequality through the host input oracle. Before rebuild, current operations read must HOLD ownership-input-changed while independent stays ready.
preconditions.exclusion: Do not renew or activate a same-result receipt between drift and the failing rebuild. That would remove the condition this case is meant to test.

payload.evaluatorSchedule: The changed source must cause base's full consumer-visible result identity to differ from baseline (assert inequality); otherwise the legitimate result-identity stop can skip operations. Permit base's structurally bound fixture review and persist its private replacement artifact; refuse operations after its deterministic recipe has actually run. Observe the real executor, not a separately reimplemented failure predicate.
payload.capturedInputRequirement: The observation and bytes ports must satisfy the F1 capture contract; each recipe consumes the capture, not a reopened mutable host path. No producer/model call is needed for a mechanical fixture.
payload.requiredResultChange: A receita base consome o snapshot B e produz body/result diferente de A; o harness observa essa diferença antes de esperar recipe/evaluate de operations.

steps: Activate valid M_before; reader ready before drift.
Change declared source; reader HOLD before attempting rebuild.

Call real rebuildOwnershipUpdate against M_before. Confirm base and operations recipe invocations. Base's private result/artifact may persist in CAS, but operations evaluation returns the injected HOLD.
Assert the call returns HOLD with no manifest property. The projection family and selected published manifest remain unchanged; do not treat CAS objects as a published candidate.
Query current operations again, then construct a fresh composed runtime and repeat read and index. Both must HOLD on changed input, with no stale body fields.
Read the independent scope through the same reopened runtime; it remains ready with its previous identity.
oracle: Failure follows an actual recipe execution/evaluator refusal, not only source staleness detection.
A failed rebuild yields no successful candidate and activates no replacement. Any partial CAS work stays private.
Current reads before/after the failed attempt and after reopen stay HOLD ownership-input-changed under the changed source; they contain no body, artifact or stale result fallback.
Current index also HOLDs, since indexOwnership shares readOwnership validation.
A raw disk predecessor may remain physically readable; the ownership reader must reject it as current when its source binding differs.
The independent scope retains its exact accepted structural identities. Provenance refusal serves nothing.

negativeControls.mutation: Skip current receipt input validation in readOwnership.
negativeControls.mustFail: Post-failure current read would return M_before's stale body ready.

negativeControls.mutation: At evaluate HOLD in rebuildOwnershipUpdate, return request.manifest as a successful candidate.
negativeControls.mustFail: The no-manifest and HOLD assertions reject the stale fallback even if no new projection was written.

evidence.finding: Obrigação AC-07 congelada; a mineração limita-se ao resíduo nomeado neste caso.
AC-07 requires separate current reader, accepted complete manifest or HOLD, and no stale fallback after a failed rebuild.
The residual proof is not established by store primitives alone.
Existing map marks both uncovered; this packet adds concrete independently rejectable scenarios instead of upgrading that map.
Frozen CONFERE is static correspondence for second store after settled commit. No rejudgment.
Source drift HOLD, then synthetic renewal published successfully, then changed candidate refusal and ready renewed incumbent.
Current drift read HOLD is real composed fixture route, but does not execute a failed rebuild.
Private executor; recipe runs, blocked output/evaluator HOLD abort; candidate only after all validations; no projection mutation.
Memory createStore and synthetic reviews; lower-level refusal tests and independent-scope preservation do not compose published stale fallback.
Refuses untrusted and obtains only a published carrier before validation.
Current input check returns HOLD; index uses same resolver; ready contains body only after closure validated.
Host-bound byte identities; compare equality/inequality only, not invented version order.
Accepted bounded synthetic renewal/source drift evidence; no accepted failed-rebuild composite is named.
F1 acceptance excludes recovery; RB-19 unchanged baseline noted.

executionGap: Requires a CI case composing the existing real-disk fixture, failed executor and reopened current reader, with logged entry/exit and exact source/manifest identities. Merely rerunning current RB-13/RB-20 cannot establish the compound case.
framingError: ownership-update.test.ts renews and publishes a current receipt before rejecting the changed-result candidate, so its later ready result is a valid renewed incumbent. Counting it as no-stale-fallback-after-failed-rebuild would reverse the sequence. An F1 PASS expressly excludes recovery.
setupQualification: Criar file:src/independent.ts na fixture antes do baseline e vinculá-lo ao scope independent. Exigir newBaseResult !== baselineBaseResult e operações realmente executadas; se o corte por resultado igual evitar a recusa, a pré-condição falhou, não houve teste de rebuild falho.
